title: Palindrome Checker
h1: Palindrome Checker — Words, Phrases and Numbers
seoTitle: Palindrome Checker — Test Words and Phrases Online
description: Check whether a word, phrase, or number reads the same forwards and backwards. Spaces and punctuation can be ignored. The check stays in your browser.
intro: Type a word, sentence, or number and see immediately if it is a palindrome. You can ignore spaces, punctuation, and letter case for phrase checks.
blurb: Test words, phrases, and numbers for palindromes without uploading your text.

controls.label: Text or number
controls.value: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

howItWorks: Enter the word, phrase, or number you want to test.
Leave the filter on to ignore spaces, punctuation, and letter case, which is the usual rule for sentence palindromes.
Press Check palindrome to see the cleaned text beside its reverse and a yes or no result.
examples: “racecar” is a palindrome even with the filter off.
“A man, a plan, a canal: Panama” is a palindrome when spaces and punctuation are ignored.

faq.a: A palindrome reads the same forwards and backwards. Words, phrases, and numbers can all qualify depending on the rules you choose.

faq.q: Why does my phrase fail when the filter is off?
faq.a: Spaces, commas, and capital letters then have to match in reverse as well. Turn the filter on for the usual phrase test.
Yes. Letters are lowercased with Unicode rules and compared by character, so accented text is not stripped unless you ignore non-letters.
